title: stackward diff v1
description: Output of `stackward diff OLD NEW --json` and `stackward audit --baseline OLD --json`: what changed between two report.v1 documents of one host. Adding an optional field is not a breaking change; removing or renaming a field, or changing a meaning, needs diff.v2. Every string comes from the two reports, cleaned of control characters and redacted.

new.description: The report compared with the baseline.

same_host.description: Both reports carry the same hostname hash. False only when --force-host compared two hosts or a report without a host.

notes.description: Caveats of this comparison (root on one side only, another profile, another stackward version). Absent when none.

drift.description: Changes on the host that matter whatever their level, ordered by kind, subject and value. A waiver does not silence drift.

coverage_lost.description: Drift checks the baseline could judge (a pass, info, warn or fail result) whose results are now all unknown or skip, or missing: drift of that kind would go unseen. Each trips --fail-on-drift any, fail and drift.

changes.description: Results added, removed or changed, ordered by group (catalog order), check id and subject. A result appearing or disappearing is listed only when it is a fail, warn or unknown or a waiver matched it.

host.description: The hostname hash; a report with a plain hostname is hashed, so a diff never prints one. Empty when the report names no host.

kind.description: listener: a NET-004 port that is new, or now listens on a wildcard or public address. authorized-key: an SSH-014 fingerprint the user did not have (or a key count that grew when a report has no fingerprints). sudoer: a USR-004 NOPASSWD principal no baseline sudoers file had. root-container: a DKR-020 container that runs as root and did not, or is new.

value.description: What is new: the port, the key fingerprint (never key material), the sudoers principal or the container. Empty for a key count.

what.description: For changed only: level, waiver or both.

old.description: The result in the baseline; absent for added.

new.description: The result in the new report; absent for removed.

new_finding.description: The result is an open fail or warn now (no waiver accepts it) and was not open in the baseline, or was open at a milder level. A finding a waiver accepts is never new, and is never shown as fixed.

level.description: The real level; a waiver never changes it.

waiver.description: The result's waiver status; absent when no waiver matched it. Only accepted keeps it from counting.
